question: What is the chemical formula for the aldehyde group?
solution:
The correct answer is__** * *– CHO.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Aldehydes are considered the most important functional group.
 
• They are often called** **the** formyl or methanoyl group**.
 
• Aldehydes derive their name from the **dehydration of alcohols**.
 
• Aldehydes contain the** carbonyl group** bonded to at least one hydrogen atom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Aldehydes are also useful as solvents and** perfume ingredients** and as intermediates in the production of dyes and pharmaceuticals.
 
• With** 40% solution in water, it forms Formalin **which is used in preserving biological specimens.
 
• Formaldehyde is used in** tanning, preparing glues and polymeric products, as germicides, insecticides,** and fungicides for plants.
 
• **-COOH ** called a **Carboxylic** **Acid**.
 
• **Alcohols **contain the hydroxy functional group (-OH), bonded** **to** **a** **carbon** **atom** **of** **an** alkyl or **substituted** alkyl group.**
